create_docker_config: create a DockerConfig with code_directory, docker_requirements, and python_path for launching PyNodes in Docker
run_to_docker_executables: run to_docker_executables to convert PyNode sequences into xm.PythonContainer executables with Docker setup
build_docker_entrypoint: build a Docker entrypoint command using process_entry.py with serialized job data and optional init file
test_docker_config_validation: test DockerConfig validation to ensure code_directory and docker_requirements are specified before launching
summarize_to_docker_executables: summarize how to_docker_executables serializes node functions, copies user code, and generates xm.PythonContainer objects
